Admin Mode Help: Includes additional configuration options, displays expandable debug menus showing program state at the bottom of exam pages, and suppresses Admin Password prompts.
Admin PIN Help: Change the Admin PIN to any numerical value. This PIN is required to switch to Admin View and to reset exams when Admin Mode is off.
Audiometry Administrator Notes Message: Unfortunately the last test was unsuccessful a second time. Please hand the tablet to an administrator. Administrators: please add any relevant notes about the previous audiometry test below.
Auto shutdown time (in minutes) for the: Auto shutdown time (in minutes) for the WAHTS headset.
Automatic Volume Control Help: Automatic Volume Control adjusts tablet output gain to compensate for differences in tablet hardware.
Automatically Output Test Results Help: Automatically upload or export the result when a test is finished. The result will be uploaded or exported on the Exam Complete page. Once the result is uploaded to a server or exported to a local file, it will be removed from TabSINT.
Default Headset Help: Select the default headset used to administer hearing tests. This selection is overridden by the headset parameter in protocols. If the protocol does not specify a headset, this value must match the value in the protocol's calibration.json file.
Disable Logs Help: Disable log messages from being stored and uploaded. Logs are useful for investigating software bugs, but may introduce privacy concerns. Disable logging anytime sensitive data is being collected.
Enable Skip in Exams Help: Allow the examiner to skip a page during an exam. This option should be used with caution as it may affect the validity of test results.
Hostname of the gitlab server instance y: Hostname of the gitlab server instance you are running. Generally this will be "https://gitlab.com/"
Ignore Firmware Updates Help: This option will ignore firmware update messages when connecting to a device. Each version of TabSINT supports a specific version of device firmware. If this option is not checked, TabSINT will show a notification if the current version of a device's firmware is not supported.
Max Log Length Help: Set the maximum number of log records to be saved. This will prevent the logs from consuming too much memory.
Only the last 30 exported results are sh: Only the last 30 exported results are shown.
Press a result in the table below to see: Press a result in the table below to see more details.
Protocol did not load properly. Please v: Protocol did not load properly. Please validate your protocol before trying to load again.
QR Code Help: Generate a QR Code containing all the current configuration settings. Select the local directory to save the QR Code for future use.
Record Test Location Help: Record the GPS location of the device when a test is started. Location data will be included in the test results.
Require Encription Help: Require that results are encrypted before they are recorded. Results will not be recorded if no public encryption key is defined in the protocol.
Reset configuration Help: Reset TabSINT configuration to the default configuration. All manual changes will be removed.
Reset Exam and Submit Partial Results: Reset Exam and Submit Partial Results
Reset TabSINT configuration to the defau: Reset TabSINT configuration to the default configuration. All manual changes will be removed.
Select Language Help: Select preferred language for the application. This language will be used where supported. Otherwise, English will be used. Note this cannot change any text configured in protocols.
Set the connection type for WAHTS device: Set the connection type for WAHTS devices.
Set the maximum number of log records to: Set the maximum number of log records to be saved. This will prevent the logs from consuming too much memory.
Set the unique TabSINT ID for the device: Set the unique TabSINT ID for the device.
TabSINT ID Edit Help: Set the unique TabSINT ID for this device.
Tablet Gain Help: Adjust the tablet output gain to calibrate audio output level.
The CHA device's connection has timed ou: The CHA device's connection has timed out.
The group where protocol, media, and res: The group where protocol, media, and result repositories are stored.
The protocol specified is not available,: The protocol specified is not available, please see the administrator.
The tympan device's connection has timed: The tympan device's connection has timed out.
Update Firmware Help: The firmware currently running on the device. If the firmware is listed in red, the firmware on the device is not supported by this version of TabSINT and should be updated.
WAHTS Communication Help: Set the connection type for WAHTS devices.
WAHTS Firmware Help: This version of the WAHTS Firmware is built into TabSINT and can be updated to the WAHTS wirelessly. TabSINT will work best if the WAHTS is updated to this version of the firmware.
Default Headset Popover:
Select the default headset used to administer hearing tests. This selection is overridden by the headset parameter in protocols.

If the protocol does not specify a headset, this value must match the value in the protocol's calibration.json file.
Admin Mode Popover: Includes additional configuration options, displays expandable debug menus showing program state at the bottom of exam pages, and suppresses Admin Password prompts.
Admin PIN Popover: Change the Admin PIN to any numerical value. This PIN is required to switch to Admin View and to reset exams when Admin Mode is off.
Disable Logs Popover:
Disable log messages from being stored and uploaded.

Logs are useful for investigating software bugs, but may introduce privacy concerns. Disable logging anytime sensitive data is being collected.
Automatically Output Test Results Popove:
Automatically upload or export the result when a test is finished. The result will be uploaded or exported on the Exam Complete page.

Once the result is uploaded to a server or exported to a local file, it will be removed from TabSINT.
Automatic Volume Control Popover:
This option will disable TabSINT from setting the volume to 100% on every page. This feature is essential to the functionality of TabSINT while playing calibrated audio through the speaker.

Check this box if you would like to set the volume of the app manually using the buttons on the side of the device.

In almost all cases, this box should remain unchecked.
Tablet Gain Popover: Apply a special gain in dB to the audio level output through TabSINT. This can be used to calibrate the audio jack output to a specified level for all audio played through the tablet.
Validate Protocol Popover:
Validate protocols against the Protocol Schema before loading into the application.

The protocol schema defines the allowable inputs for use in protocols.
Protocol Server Popover:
Choose the location to use as the protocol source and results output.

Additional configuration for Gitlab will become active below this box when it is selected.
Protocol Table Popover:
The table below shows a list of the available test protocols within TabSINT. You can select a protocol by pressing on the table row, then load, update, or delete the protocol using the buttons below.

Protocols can be added from each of the servers listed on the Configuration page using the pane below this one. The input area will change depending on the server selected.
Media Table Popover: This table shows a list of the downloaded media repositories. These repositories can be referenced by any protocols using the commonMediaRepository key in the top level of the protocol.
Media Add Popover:
Type in the name of a repository to use as a common media repository.

The repository must be located on the host in the group defined in the Gitlab Configuration pane under the Configuration tab.
Server Default Popover: Reset all configuration values to the defaults set in the build configuration file. This file can only be edited when TabSINT is built from source code.
Gitlab Add Popover: Type in the name of the protocol repository located on the host and group. If applicable, put all parent directories in the group field.
Gitlab Add Version Popover: OPTIONAL: Type in the repository tag for the version of the repository you would like to download. Leave blank to download the latest tag/commit from the repository.
Gitlab Token Popover: The secret token used to access your gitlab repositories. See the user guide for more information about finding the Token.
Gitlab Use Tags Popover:
By default, TabSINT will track changes to protocol files based on the tags to a repository.

Uncheck this box if you would only like to download changes that are associated with repository commits.
Gitlab Separate Results Repo Popover:
Select this option to choose a different gitlab group or repository for results upload.

By default, results are uploaded to a results repository in the same group that contains the protocol.
Gitlab Results Group Popover:
Type the group that contains the Results Repository specified below.

Note: This group must use the same Host and Token above.
Gitlab Results Repo Popover:
Type the name of the repository where results will be uploaded. To avoid errors, please create the repository before trying to upload results to it.

Note: This repository must use the same Host and Token above.
Download Creare Protocols Popover: Select this option to download standard protocols from Creare. Results will still go to the gitlab host, group, and repository defined in Gitlab Configuration on the Configuration tab. When this option is not selected, protocols are downloaded from the host and group defined in Gitlab Configuration on the Configuration tab.
Local Add Popover: The local directory under Documents/tabsint-protocols where the protocol is stored on the tablet. Press Add to select a protocol directory via a file chooser.
